rules.title: Largest Contentful Paint
rules.description: Record lab/field source, value, conditions and LCP element when available.
rules.recommendationTemplate: Remove what delays the largest element: do not lazy-load it, give it high fetch priority, and keep it out of render-blocking chains. Re-measure with the same conditions.
rules.evaluationPrompt: Interpret the measured evidence for "Largest Contentful Paint". Record lab/field source, value, conditions and LCP element when available. Do not guess beyond the measurements supplied.

rules.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
rules.description: Record shift clusters, affected elements and observation window.
rules.recommendationTemplate: Reserve space for what loads late (width and height on images, a fixed slot for embeds) so content stops moving. Re-measure with the same conditions.
rules.evaluationPrompt: Interpret the measured evidence for "Cumulative Layout Shift". Record shift clusters, affected elements and observation window. Do not guess beyond the measurements supplied.
